description: A grid heading that overflows its column by a few pixels rather than by most of its width. Measured with the grid's own title font, this Arabic heading needs 124 pixels in a column drawn at 115 - nine short, which is enough to clip the first letter and not enough to look like a fault in a screenshot. The German heading in contract 06 overflows by most of its width and has always been widened; this asks whether a small overflow is treated as an overflow at all.
